items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: that's when we had Bechet, Albert Nicholas, Sidney DeParis, and the whole eight

ctx.x: One of the records -- this one that he gave me with these four taken for the master record was recorded, was taken off in France. Bechet wasn't on that

date. It was nothing but Albert Nicholas, myself, Sidney DeParis, Freddy -- oh, used to be with Louie and did a lot of recording with Jelly in Chicago -- Freddy Robinson was on trombone. And Jug -- not Jug on piano -- and William Brault Brothers on bass, and Sidney DeParis on trumpet. But when we made the big recordings, which had happened in 1939, this was recorded again in September, and we carved it in round about July, and that's when we had Bechet, Albert Nicholas, Sidney DeParis, and the whole eight --…
Well, how did that session go?
